note: The ladder catalogue ships EMPTY. Every pipeline this board ships is a PDL document in pipeline-bundle.seed.json: the seven that used to live here (local, investigate, turnover, github-investigate, sefl-investigate, github-force-merge, sefl-review-loop) were converted stage for stage, prompts and intent kept, and the four studio pipelines were already there. The ladder is still the TREE record's (local -> investigation -> turnover, docs/pipelines.md 1.2) and a reader may still write their own definitions into pipelines.json, which overrides this file per id; but nothing ships here, so the Settings dropdown and the catalogue offer PDL only. A definition written here must pass the same validation as one the reader writes: a stage without an exit, a check outside the closed vocabulary, an unknown {{placeholder}} or a `next` that goes backwards is dropped BY ID and named in the log.
